# PopGenR

PopGenR is an R package for common population genetics workflows on VCF
and PLINK-style genotype data. It includes helpers for allele
frequencies, heterozygosity, nucleotide diversity, Watterson’s theta,
Tajima’s D, linkage disequilibrium, PLINK quality control, runs of
homozygosity, and annotation of genomic regions or single positions with
gene names.

## Features

- Read VCF files into analysis-ready data frames with
  [`read.vcf()`](https://malikbak.github.io/PopGenR/reference/read.vcf.md).
- Summarize genotype counts, allele frequencies, minor allele frequency,
  and expected heterozygosity.
- Calculate diversity statistics such as nucleotide diversity, Dxy,
  Watterson’s theta, and Tajima’s D.
- Calculate pooled heterozygosity
  ([`Hetp()`](https://malikbak.github.io/PopGenR/reference/Hetp.md))
  across genomic windows.
- Calculate pairwise linkage disequilibrium
  ([`calc_r2()`](https://malikbak.github.io/PopGenR/reference/calc_r2.md)).
- Run PLINK QC/PCA
  ([`plQC()`](https://malikbak.github.io/PopGenR/reference/plQC.md)) and
  runs of homozygosity
  ([`RunHom()`](https://malikbak.github.io/PopGenR/reference/RunHom.md)).
- Annotate ranges
  ([`AnnoRan()`](https://malikbak.github.io/PopGenR/reference/AnnoRan.md))
  and single positions
  ([`AnnoSin()`](https://malikbak.github.io/PopGenR/reference/AnnoSin.md))
  with gene annotation data.

## Installation

Install the development version from GitHub:

``` r

install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_git("https://github.com/malikbak/PopGenR.git")
```

PopGenR imports `data.table`, `dplyr`, `ggplot2`, and `vcfR`. Reading
GFF/GTF annotation files with
[`AnnoRan()`](https://malikbak.github.io/PopGenR/reference/AnnoRan.md)
also requires `rtracklayer`, which is a Bioconductor package:

``` r

install.packages("BiocManager")
BiocManager::install("rtracklayer")
```

## Quick Start

``` r

library(PopGenR)

genotypes <- c("0/0", "0/1", "1/0", "1/1", "./.")

counts <- count.genotypes(genotypes)
counts

allele.freq(counts)
expected.het(genotypes)
```

Annotate genomic intervals with an annotation data frame:

``` r

regions <- data.frame(
  chr = c("1", "1"),
  start = c(1000, 5000),
  end = c(2000, 6500)
)

genes <- data.frame(
  chromosome_name = c("1", "1"),
  start_position = c(1200, 5500),
  end_position = c(1800, 6000),
  external_gene_name = c("GeneA", "GeneB")
)

AnnoRan(regions, CHR = "chr", starP = "start", endP = "end", annotation = genes)
```

Run window-based statistics on a VCF:

``` r

tajima <- TajimaD("path/to/sample.vcf", window_size = 150000)
hp <- Hetp("path/to/sample.vcf", window_size = 150000)
```

Run PLINK QC and PCA:

``` r

p <- plQC(file = "path/to/plink_prefix", maf = 0.05, chrset = 30)
p
```

The PLINK helpers can use a local development copy of
`extdata/plink/plink.exe` when present, or you can pass
`plink_path = "path/to/plink"` to use your own PLINK installation.

## Developer Workflow

Regenerate function documentation:

``` r

roxygen2::roxygenise()
```

Build and check the package:

``` r

devtools::document()
devtools::check()
```

Build the package manual:

``` powershell
& "C:\Program Files\R\R-4.6.0\bin\R.exe" CMD Rd2pdf . --output=PopGenR-manual.pdf
```

Build the pkgdown site:

``` r

pkgdown::build_site()
```

The generated site is written to `docs/`, which can be published with
GitHub Pages.

# Package index

## VCF Input and Genotype Helpers

- [`read.vcf()`](https://malikbak.github.io/PopGenR/reference/read.vcf.md)
  : read.vcf: Read and Clean VCF Files
- [`get.field()`](https://malikbak.github.io/PopGenR/reference/get.field.md)
  : get.field: Extract Specific Field from Genotype Data
- [`count.genotypes()`](https://malikbak.github.io/PopGenR/reference/count.genotypes.md)
  : count.genotypes: Count Genotypes from Genotype Data
- [`allele.freq()`](https://malikbak.github.io/PopGenR/reference/allele.freq.md)
  : allele.freq: Calculate Allele Frequencies from Genotype Counts
- [`maf()`](https://malikbak.github.io/PopGenR/reference/maf.md) : maf:
  Calculate Minor Allele Frequency (MAF) from VCF Row
- [`get.haplotypes()`](https://malikbak.github.io/PopGenR/reference/get.haplotypes.md)
  : get.haplotypes: Generate Haplotype Combinations from Genotype Data
- [`derivedCount()`](https://malikbak.github.io/PopGenR/reference/derivedCount.md)
  : derivedCount: Calculate Derived Allele Count from Genotype Data

## Diversity and Selection Statistics

- [`expected.het()`](https://malikbak.github.io/PopGenR/reference/expected.het.md)
  : expected.het: Calculate Expected Heterozygosity from Genotype Data
- [`pi.diversity()`](https://malikbak.github.io/PopGenR/reference/pi.diversity.md)
  : pi.diversity: Calculate Nucleotide Diversity (Pi) from VCF Data
- [`dnuc()`](https://malikbak.github.io/PopGenR/reference/dnuc.md) :
  dnuc: Calculate Nucleotide Diversity (Dxy) Between Two Populations
- [`waterson.theta()`](https://malikbak.github.io/PopGenR/reference/waterson.theta.md)
  : waterson.theta: Calculate Watterson's Theta from Genetic Data
- [`variance.d()`](https://malikbak.github.io/PopGenR/reference/variance.d.md)
  : variance.d: Calculate Variance of the Genetic Diversity Index (D)
- [`TajimaD()`](https://malikbak.github.io/PopGenR/reference/TajimaD.md)
  : Calculate Tajima's D by Genomic Window
- [`Hetp()`](https://malikbak.github.io/PopGenR/reference/Hetp.md) :
  Calculate Pooled Heterozygosity by Genomic Window
- [`calc_r2()`](https://malikbak.github.io/PopGenR/reference/calc_r2.md)
  : calc_r2: Calculate Linkage Disequilibrium (R²) Between Two Variants
- [`fixed.poly()`](https://malikbak.github.io/PopGenR/reference/fixed.poly.md)
  : fixed.poly: Identify Fixed and Polymorphic Sites Between Two
  Populations

## Annotation

- [`AnnoRan()`](https://malikbak.github.io/PopGenR/reference/AnnoRan.md)
  : Annotate Genomic Regions with Gene Names
- [`AnnoSin()`](https://malikbak.github.io/PopGenR/reference/AnnoSin.md)
  : Annotate Single Genomic Positions with Gene Names

## External Tools

- [`plQC()`](https://malikbak.github.io/PopGenR/reference/plQC.md) : Run
  PLINK Quality Control and Plot PCA
- [`RunHom()`](https://malikbak.github.io/PopGenR/reference/RunHom.md) :
  Run PLINK Runs of Homozygosity
- [`Mbed()`](https://malikbak.github.io/PopGenR/reference/Mbed.md) :
  Create Fixed-Width BED Windows with bedtools
